defects.cause: The retry attempt number changes the gateway idempotency key for the same order.
defects.trigger: A first charge commits but its response times out; the second attempt uses another key.
defects.consequence: One purchase charges the customer twice.
defects.boundary: External payment side effect and retry identity
defects.evidence: The key includes str(attempt), while gateway.charge deduplicates only identical keys.
defects.proof: oracle.py executes an in-memory gateway that records committed charges before losing the first response; head records two charges, fixed control records one.
